meta.title: Repetition Guard
meta.description: Stops DeepSeek Harness generation as soon as the same string repeats >=10 times in a row and commits the partial answer. Fenced, inline and indented code share one relaxed threshold (threshold x codeBlockMultiplier); repeat counts can follow unit length through a piecewise table or a JS module; the whitelist, detection window and table-derived unit lengths are written back automatically, so settings changes need no restart. Stop notices offer an optional continue instruction and an opt-in browser system notification. Verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (CLI and desktop), host API >= 0.1.1.
